--a दण्डनाथा, attacked बला- haka and his brothers; rode on Tamolipta विमान. Aimed at them the Mohana arrow which created darkness all round; wore on her neck a garland of the severed heads;
1: Br. IV. २४. ७४, ९८.
(this दण्डनी) all शक्तिस् praised.
2: Ib. IV. २४. १०३; ३६. २५.
--the origin of the different creatures described. वा. ६९. २९८-303.
--one of the names in the first Marut गण. वा. ६७. १२३.
--sixfold; to take birth and undergo all diffi- culties. वा. १०२. ७२.

--at the beginning of creation and when the whole was enveloped in darkness a cross current passed in and resulted in a second universe: २८ parts, ११ senses, 9 udayas, 8 stars; light in as also out; this resulted in सात्विक. वा. 6. ४१-7, ५६.
--a daughter of क्रोधा, the wife of Pulaha. Br. III. 7. १७२. [page२-026+ ३७]
--a righteous person fit to receive a दान। वा. ९१. १११.

--a custom of going on pilgrimage. Vidura undertook one.
1: भा. I. १३. 1.
Not fruitful to the unfaithful,
2: Br. III. १३. १३५-6; ६६. ४३; IV. 9. 7.
of गाधि; rules that one should not ride in a vehicle but walk;
3: M. १०६. 3; ११२. २०.
of Arjuna.
4: Ib. २४४. 3.
--the Lord of the holy waters; प्रयाग, to honour which is to honour the Lord of the waters. M. १०९. १५.

--prescriptions for;
1: वा. ११०. २८-66.
merits of; rituals at different sacred places of गया; could be done at any time in the presence of any with no आवाहन; the performer must observe celibacy, live on one meal a day, take bed on the earth and be truthful and pure to get full merits.
2: Ib. १०५. ३७-41.
--going on pilgrimage for sacred baths. Vi. III. 9. १२.

--sacred places of pilgrimage; as frequented by पिशाचस्;

श्राद्धस् at; enumeration of a number of them for श्राद्ध offerings.
2: Br. III. १३ (whole); M. १५. १७.
First गुरुतीर्थम्, then ध्यान- तीर्थम्, and lastly ब्रह्मतीर्थम्,
3: Br. III. २२. 6; २४. ३९.
परशुराम went about to purify himself;
